title: Validity of Postponed Sources
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $\rho$ assign a natural number to each of the eleven registers, let $W\in\mathbb N$, and let $t_0$ be Boolean. If $t_0$ is false, assume $1\leq\rho(r_{LB})$. Every source in the length-$W$ list whose entries are constant false when $t_0$ is true and postponed sources at positions $j=0,\ldots,W-1$ otherwise is valid for $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$\rho$ assigns a natural number to each of eleven registers
replaced:
Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $k$ be its
work-tape parameter, let $W\in\mathbb N$, and let
$t_0\in\{\mathrm{true},\mathrm{false}\}$. Suppose that if $t_0=\mathrm{false}$, then
$1\leq \rho(r_{LB})$, where $\rho$ assigns a natural number to each of the eleven
registers. Every source in the length-$W$ list whose entries are constant false when
$t_0$ is true and postponed sources otherwise satisfies the source validity conditions
for $\rho$.
